limits: Local source review and mocked headless tests only; no Person/Queue/Backend/Native qualification or external IO.

resolvedFindings.problem: Submission may become disabled while saveName awaits; subsequent code still allocates UUIDs and retains a frozen attempt although onSave is skipped.
resolvedFindings.repair: Recheck latestSubmission immediately after saveName and before creating IDs; retain existing pre-onSave guard; test deferred saveName disable.

resolvedFindings.problem: Enabled no-port form retains ready=true when disabled later, leaving input editable and old onChange mutating an unpersisted draft.
resolvedFindings.repair: Gate editable and onChange by presence of a draft port or current enabled submission; test enabled-to-disabled no-port retained input callback.

resolution: Immediately after saveName, validity and latest submission are checked before any UUID allocation or retainAttempt. Disabled pending name save remains an unsubmitted cancellable draft.
Both editable state and retained onChange gate require a durable draft port or enabled submission, including enabled-to-disabled transitions.
Default submissionEnabled=true maintains existing normal path; false preserves bound local drafts without onSave or authority.
